1a5558a0-9549-459f-9f25-0694b6b5bd55.quote: Cuban Noobster ate the second most damage on our team and died once, early, to Grux. Kwang finished the game without a kill. That is what a frontline offlane is supposed to look like.
1a5558a0-9549-459f-9f25-0694b6b5bd55.issue: implied credit: Kwang's zero kills is not attributable to Scarlett (Kwang out-damaged Scarlett 36593 to 32927; Bayle took three of Kwang's five deaths)

1a5558a0-9549-459f-9f25-0694b6b5bd55.quote: Skylar died first, to Legion, and the team still turned it 4-1 while their outer and inner towers fell. One of our outer towers dropped in the same window. 1a5558a0-9549-459f-9f25-0694b6b5bd55.issue: positioning not in data: 'the frontline stands between Legion and Skylar' and 'bailout' imply an observed positioning failure; a first death does not prove a preventable mistake

Adele roots with Imperial Lash and Queen's Garden, mesmerizes with Royal Flourish and supplied most of their healing; Legion slows with Saturation Charge and knocks back with Rally Point. Across the match Gideon was their top damage dealer with magical burst, while Grux's pull and stuns and Kwang's knockup were the lockdown threats.

1a5558a0-9549-459f-9f25-0694b6b5bd55.quote: Heavy Metal adds magical on-hit damage to Steel's punches and Shield Bash based on total physical and magical armor. Every armor item in this build feeds it, so the augment and the inventory pull the same way. Colossal Crash is the alternative when a longer, wider Shield Slam matters more, trading its knockup and stun for a knockback.
1a5558a0-9549-459f-9f25-0694b6b5bd55.issue: augment mechanic overstated: catalog says Colossal Crash knocks back 'instead' of the knockup; it does not say the stun is lost
1a5558a0-9549-459f-9f25-0694b6b5bd55.rewrite: Heavy Metal adds magical on-hit damage to Steel's heavy punches and Shield Bash based on total physical and magical armor. Every armor item in this build feeds Heavy Metal, so the augment and the inventory pull the same way. Colossal Crash is the alternative when a longer, wider Shield Slam matters more, trading the knockup for a knockback.
